evidence.quoted_text:
- A run whose ToolPolicy does not request grep never probes and records
  nothing (the distinguishable not-configured state).
evidence.reason: The surrounding README text says the ripgrep probe decides whether grep/glob stay on the surface or are withheld when rg is absent or too old. A glob-only ToolPolicy therefore needs the probe even though it does not request grep. Lines 175-176 state the no-probe condition as "does not request grep", which conflicts with that described behavior; the finding's correction to "neither grep nor glob" is the smallest compatible documentation fix.
